text: Kingsmoor FC build an attack starting from a throw-in deep in their own half on the right side. The ball moves patiently through the midfield and forward lines, mainly along the right flank, involving players like Hamza Strand and Rafael Sato. Viktor Quinlan receives a long pass near the edge of the Westport Albion penalty area on the left side of the attacking end and quickly plays a short pass to Felix Duarte, who shoots with his foot from about 3.8 metres out. Duarte’s shot goes off target, missing a clear chance while the score remains 2-2 in the 38th minute [#695] [#709] [#710] [#713].
